Rotation of the element relative to the path (auto follows the tangent).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;basefont&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px">body { font-family: Verdana; font-size: 14px; } — that replaced <basefont></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;basefont face=&quot;Verdana&quot; size=&quot;2&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>offset-rotate</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>basefont { offset-rotate: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Rotation of the element relative to the path (auto follows the tangent).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>left</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>offset-rotate</code></li><li>C. <code>font-variation-settings</code></li><li>D. <code>list-style-position</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5103">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5104 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5105">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5105" data-page="5105" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4228"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5105 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4228 — del × margin-bottom</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">del</span> <span class="badge prop">margin-bottom</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">margin-bottom</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;del&gt;</code> — marks text removed from the document (change tracking). Distance below the element.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;del&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px"><del style="color:#9ca3af">Old price: $99</del> → <b>$79</b> <small>(deleted 2026-09-10)</small></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;del datetime=&quot;2026-09-10&quot;&gt;Old price: $99&lt;/del&gt; → $79</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-bottom</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>del { margin-bottom: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by class attribute (the workhorse).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>.class</code></li><li>B. <code>:active</code></li><li>C. <code>:empty</code></li><li>D. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5104">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5105 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5106">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5106" data-page="5106" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4229"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5106 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4229 — meta × border-style</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">meta</span> <span class="badge prop">border-style</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border-style</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;meta&gt;</code> — machine-readable metadata about the document (encoding, viewport, description, authors). The line style of the border (all sides, 1–4 values).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;meta&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">charset=UTF-8<br>viewport=width=device-width<br>description="A huge HTML+CSS reference."</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;meta charset=&quot;UTF-8&quot;&gt; &lt;meta name=&quot;viewport&quot; content=&quot;width=device-width, initial-scale=1&quot;&gt; &lt;meta name=&quot;description&quot; content=&quot;A huge HTML+CSS reference.&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border-style</b> = <b>solid</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>meta { border-style: solid; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches when the attribute equals a value (exact, case-sensitive).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:only-child</code></li><li>B. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li><li>C. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>[attr=value]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5105">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5106 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5107">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5107" data-page="5107" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4230"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5107 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4230 — section × top</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">section</span> <span class="badge prop">top</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">top</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;section&gt;</code> — a thematic grouping of content, typically with a heading. Limits an element&#x27;s side effects (layout, paint, size, style) to its subtree.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;address&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-style:italic;font-size:13px;border:1px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 12px;background:#fafbfc"><a href="#" style="color:#1a56db">hi@example.com</a> · Cairo, Egypt</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;address&gt; &lt;a href=&quot;mailto:hi@example.com&quot;&gt;hi@example.com&lt;/a&gt; · Cairo, EG &lt;/address&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>contain</b> = <b>paint</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>address { contain: paint; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? Size of implicitly created columns (when items overflow the template).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;blockquote&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border-left:4px solid #6b7280;margin-left:8px;padding-left:12px;color:#374151;font-size:13px;font-style:italic">“The power to affect the world comes from the ability to connect people.”</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;blockquote cite=&quot;https://www.w3.org/&quot;&gt;The power to affect the world...&lt;/blockquote&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-auto-columns</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>blockquote { grid-auto-columns: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The n-th child (An+B formulas).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>C. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>D. <code>::backdrop</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5109">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5110 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5111">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5111" data-page="5111" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4234"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5111 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4234 — i × font-variant</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">i</span> <span class="badge prop">font-variant</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-variant</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;i&gt;</code> — text in an alternate voice or mood (technical terms, foreign phrases, ship names). Compact switch for small caps and other variants.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;i&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">The word <i>rendezvous</i> is borrowed from French.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;The word &lt;i&gt;rendezvous&lt;/i&gt; is borrowed from French.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-variant</b> = <b>small-caps</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>i { font-variant: small-caps; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last of its tag among siblings.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>::before</code></li><li>D. <code>*</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5110">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5111 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5112">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5112" data-page="5112" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4235"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5112 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4235 — q × text-transform</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">q</span> <span class="badge prop">text-transform</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-transform</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;q&gt;</code> — a short inline quotation (rendered with quotation marks). Change the case of the text (uppercase, lowercase, capitalize).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;q&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">As the docs say, <q>HTML is the skeleton</q>.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;As the docs say, &lt;q cite=&quot;https://w3.org/&quot;&gt;HTML is the skeleton&lt;/q&gt;.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-transform</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>q { text-transform: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches if ANY listed selector matches (zero specificity!).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>B. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>C. <code>#id</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5111">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5112 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5113">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5113" data-page="5113" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4236"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5113 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4236 — code × orphans</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">code</span> <span class="badge prop">orphans</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">orphans</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;code&gt;</code> — a fragment of computer code. Minimum lines of a paragraph that must stay at the bottom of a page.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;code&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Use <code style="font-family:monospace;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">display: grid</code> for layouts.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Use &lt;code&gt;display: grid&lt;/code&gt; for layouts.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>orphans</b> = <b>integer</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>code { orphans: integer; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Checkbox/radio is checked.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:checked</code></li><li>B. <code>+</code></li><li>C. <code>::marker</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5112">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5113 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5114">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5114" data-page="5114" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4237"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5114 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4237 — bdi × background-repeat</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">bdi</span> <span class="badge prop">background-repeat</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-repeat</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;bdi&gt;</code> — isolates text so its direction does not affect surrounding text. Isolate the element from blend modes above/below it.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dd&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;color:#4b5563;margin-left:18px">World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet. <i>(dd)</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;Web&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet.&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>isolation</b> = <b>isolate</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dd { isolation: isolate; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is the target of the URL fragment (#id).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>.class</code></li><li>D. <code>:focus-visible</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5114">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5115 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5116">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5116" data-page="5116" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4239"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5116 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4239 — canvas × quotes</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">canvas</span> <span class="badge prop">quotes</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">quotes</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;canvas&gt;</code> — a bitmap drawing surface controlled by the 2d api or webgl. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The dominant, unique content of the document.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;var&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;main&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;tbody&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;p&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5158">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5159 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5160">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5160" data-page="5160" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4283"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5160 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4283 — title × text-orientation</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">title</span> <span class="badge prop">text-orientation</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-orientation</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;title&gt;</code> — defines the document title, shown in the browser tab and search results. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The caption for a &lt;figure&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;ruby&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;figcaption&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;th&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;wbr&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5159">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5160 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5161">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5161" data-page="5161" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4284"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5161 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4284 — template × caret-color</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">template</span> <span class="badge prop">caret-color</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">caret-color</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;template&gt;</code> — an inert container of markup that can be cloned by javascript. content is <b>inert</b> — rendered only when JS clones it into the DOM</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;template id=&quot;card&quot;&gt; &lt;div class=&quot;card&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;/h3&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;/p&gt;&lt;/div&gt; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 3 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;bdi&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;center&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;details&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;h3&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5160">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5161 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5162">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5162" data-page="5162" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4285"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5162 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4285 — header × shape-margin</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">header</span> <span class="badge prop">shape-margin</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">shape-margin</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;header&gt;</code> — introductory content or a set of navigational links for a section or page. Extra clearance around a shape-outside shape.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;header&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4285f4,#34a853);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:#fff"><b style="font-size:15px">My Blog</b><div style="font-size:11px;opacity:.85;margin-top:2px">header — intro content for the page</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;header&gt; &lt;h1&gt;My Blog&lt;/h1&gt; &lt;nav&gt;...&lt;/nav&gt; &lt;/header&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>shape-margin</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>header { shape-margin: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section heading of importance level 6 (h1 = highest).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;ol&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;blink&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;span&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;h6&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5161">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5162 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5163">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5163" data-page="5163" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4286"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5163 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4286 — h2 × pointer-events</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h2</span> <span class="badge prop">pointer-events</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">pointer-events</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h2&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 2 (h1 = highest). Whether the element can be dragged (legacy, mostly images).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;br&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;background:#fafbfc;border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:8px;border-radius:6px">12 Main St.<br>Cairo, Egypt<br>12611</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;address&gt;12 Main St.&lt;br&gt;Cairo, Egypt&lt;br&gt;12611&lt;/address&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>user-drag</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>br { user-drag: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section quoted from another source.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;picture&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;blockquote&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;noframes&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;s&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5163">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5164 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5165">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5165" data-page="5165" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4288"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5165 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4288 — span × animation-direction</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">span</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-direction</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-direction</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;span&gt;</code> — a neutral inline container with no meaning. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A native dialog box: modal when shown with showModal(), non-modal when shown with show().”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;audio&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;isindex&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;dialog&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;cite&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5164">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5165 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5166">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5166" data-page="5166" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4289"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5166 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4289 — small × offset-path</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">small</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-path</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-path</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;small&gt;</code> — side comments and small print: fine print, copyrights, legal notes. Distance above the element (outside its border).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;time&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Published <time datetime="2026-09-16" style="color:#1a56db;font-weight:600">16 September 2026</time></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;time datetime=&quot;2026-09-16&quot;&gt;16 September 2026&lt;/time&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-top</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>time { margin-top: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Non-extractive information: a spell-check red line, a signature.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;u&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;embed&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;del&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;kbd&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5166">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5167 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5168">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5168" data-page="5168" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4291"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5168 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4291 — ruby × border</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">ruby</span> <span class="badge prop">border</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;ruby&gt;</code> — japanese/chinese pinyin-style pronunciation annotation. Shorthand: width + style + color for the whole border.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ruby&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:serif"><ruby>中<rt style="font-size:9px">zhōng</rt></ruby>国<rp>(</rp><rt style="font-size:9px">guó</rt><rp>)</rp></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;中&lt;rt&gt;zhōng&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;&lt;ruby&gt;国&lt;rt&gt;guó&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>border</b> = <b>1px solid #d1d5db</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ruby { border: 1px solid #d1d5db; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Highlights text for reference, like a highlighter pen.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;map&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;head&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;mark&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;var&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5167">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5168 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5169">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5169" data-page="5169" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4292"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5169 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4292 — li × clear</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">li</span> <span class="badge prop">clear</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">clear</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;li&gt;</code> — a single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; or &lt;menu&gt;. Prevents floats on one or both sides (moves the box below them).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;li&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Start</li><li value="10">Jumps to 10</li><li>Then 11</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol&gt; &lt;li&gt;Start&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li value=&quot;10&quot;&gt;Jumps to 10&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Then 11&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>clear</b> = <b>both</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>li { clear: both; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “An abbreviation or acronym, with its expansion in the title attribute.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;input&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;link&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;abbr&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;ruby&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5168">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5169 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5170">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5170" data-page="5170" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4293"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5170 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4293 — video × content-visibility</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">video</span> <span class="badge prop">content-visibility</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">content-visibility</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;video&gt;</code> — embeds a video player with optional controls, autoplay, loop and captions. Skip rendering of off-screen subtrees (auto + contain-intrinsic-size).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;video&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:230px;height:120px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a5f,#0f172a);border-radius:8px;position:relative"><span style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center"><span style="width:0;height:0;border-left:22px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-top:14px solid transparent;border-bottom:14px solid transparent"></span></span><span style="position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:8px;font-size:10px;color:#e5e7eb">▶ clip.mp4 — controls</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls width=&quot;320&quot; poster=&quot;thumb.jpg&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.webm&quot; type=&quot;video/webm&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.mp4&quot; type=&quot;video/mp4&quot;&gt; &lt;track kind=&quot;captions&quot; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A named parameter passed to an &lt;object&gt; resource.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;basefont&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;span&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;param&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5179">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5180 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5181">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5181" data-page="5181" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4304"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5181 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4304 — h1 × transform</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h1</span> <span class="badge prop">transform</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">transform</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h1&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 1 (h1 = highest). Move/rotate/scale/skew the element (GPU-friendly, doesn&#x27;t reflow).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;h1&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-weight:700;font-size:23.5px;line-height:1.25;margin:2px 0">Heading level 1</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;h1&gt;Heading level 1&lt;/h1&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>transform</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>h1 { transform: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A section for user input, submitted to a server.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;dir&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;i&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;form&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;legend&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5180">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5181 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5182">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5182" data-page="5182" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4305"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5182 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4305 — hr × height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">hr</span> <span class="badge prop">height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;hr&gt;</code> — a thematic break between paragraphs (scene change, topic shift). Space between columns (grid columns / flex columns).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ol&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol start="2" style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Second step</li><li>Third step</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol start=&quot;2&quot;&gt; &lt;li&gt;Second step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Third step&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>column-gap</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ol { column-gap: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Groups the footer (summary) rows of a table.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;section&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;tfoot&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;ruby&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;tt&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5186">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5187 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5188">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5188" data-page="5188" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4311"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5188 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4311 — source × place-content</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">source</span> <span class="badge prop">place-content</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">place-content</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;source&gt;</code> — a candidate resource for &lt;video&gt;, &lt;audio&gt; or &lt;picture&gt;. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A standard data cell.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;nav&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;bdi&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;td&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;frameset&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5187">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5188 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5189">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5189" data-page="5189" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4312"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5189 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4312 — iframe × font-kerning</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">iframe</span> <span class="badge prop">font-kerning</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">font-kerning</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;iframe&gt;</code> — embeds another html page in a nested browsing context. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Legacy/obsolete element: Marquee (obsolete).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;main&gt;</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>&lt;marquee&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;ol&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;basefont&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5188">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5189 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5190">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5190" data-page="5190" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4313"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5190 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4313 — input × text-underline-offset</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">input</span> <span class="badge prop">text-underline-offset</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-underline-offset</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;input&gt;</code> — the most versatile form control: text, email, number, date, file, checkbox, radio, range, color, search and more. Distance between the underline and the text.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;input&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><form style="display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:12px;max-width:250px"><label style="display:grid;gap:3px"><b>Full name</b><input style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></label><label style="display:grid;gap:3px"><b>Email</b><input type="email" style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></label><label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><input type="checkbox" checked> Newsletter</label><button style="justify-self:start;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 16px">Send</button></form></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form&gt; &lt;label&gt;Full name &lt;input type=&quot;text&quot; name=&quot;name&quot; required autocomplete=&quot;name&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Email &lt;input type=&quot;email&quot; name=&quot;email&quot; required&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Age &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; name=&quot;age&quot; min=&quot;0&quot; max=&quot;120&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; Shorthand: font-style font-variant font-weight font-size/line-height font-family.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;big&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="font-size:15px">Bigger text — via CSS font-size</span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;big&gt;Bigger text&lt;/big&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>big { font: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is under the pointer.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:empty</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:hover</code></li><li>C. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>D. <code>::before</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5265">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5266 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5267">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5267" data-page="5267" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4390"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5267 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4390 — noframes × letter-spacing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">noframes</span> <span class="badge prop">letter-spacing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">letter-spacing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;noframes&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: no frames fallback (obsolete). Space between letters (tracking).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;noframes&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;color:#9ca3af">Frames are gone — so is <noframes>.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;noframes&gt;Your browser doesn&#x27;t support frames.&lt;/noframes&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>letter-spacing</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>noframes { letter-spacing: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The element is being pressed/clicked.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li><li>B. <code>:target</code></li><li>C. <code>::first-line</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:active</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5266">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5267 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5268">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5268" data-page="5268" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4391"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5268 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4391 — slot × vertical-align</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">slot</span> <span class="badge prop">vertical-align</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">vertical-align</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;slot&gt;</code> — a placeholder in a shadow dom template where light-dom content is projected. Aligns inline content to the baseline (icons with text!).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;slot&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><span style="color:#0d9488;font-size:13px">Hello shadow <i>(projected into the slot)</i></span></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;template shadowrootmode=&quot;open&quot;&gt; &lt;style&gt;span { color: teal; }&lt;/style&gt; &lt;span&gt;&lt;slot&gt;&lt;/slot&gt;&lt;/span&gt; &lt;/template&gt; &lt;my-comp&gt;Hello shadow&lt;/my-comp&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>vertical-align</b> = <b>middle</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>slot { vertical-align: middle; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The sole child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>::marker</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:only-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5267">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5268 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5269">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5269" data-page="5269" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4392"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5269 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4392 — base × background</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">base</span> <span class="badge prop">background</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;base&gt;</code> — sets the base url for all relative urls on the page. Shorthand: color + image + position + size + repeat + attachment + origin + clip.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;base&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">base URL = https://docs.example.com/ → &lt;img src="a.png"&gt; loads docs.example.com/a.png</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;base href=&quot;https://docs.example.com/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background</b> = <b>linear-gradient(90deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed)</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>base { background: linear-gradient(90deg,#2563eb,#7c3aed); }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “First of its tag among siblings.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>C. <code>~</code></li><li>D. <code>::cue</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5268">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5269 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5270">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5270" data-page="5270" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4393"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5270 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4393 — body × forced-color-adjust</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">body</span> <span class="badge prop">forced-color-adjust</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">forced-color-adjust</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;body&gt;</code> — contains all the visible content of the html document. Whether the OS &#x27;forced colors&#x27; mode (Windows High Contrast) overrides colors.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;body&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:2px solid #d0d7de;border-radius:8px;padding:12px;background:#fff"><h1 style="margin:0 0 6px;font-size:18px">Hello</h1><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Everything visible lives inside <b>&lt;body&gt;</b></p></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;body&gt; &lt;h1&gt;Hello&lt;/h1&gt; &lt;p&gt;World&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/body&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>forced-color-adjust</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>body { forced-color-adjust: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Everything EXCEPT the selector inside.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:lang(code)</code></li><li>B. <code>::first-letter</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>.class</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5269">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5270 / 8000 · Practice 22</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5271">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5271" data-page="5271" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4394"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 22</span><span>Page 5271 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4394 — footer × list-style-position</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">footer</span> <span class="badge prop">list-style-position</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">list-style-position</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;footer&gt;</code> — footer content for a page or section: copyright, contact, related links. Where the marker sits: inside or outside the box.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;footer&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="background:#111827;color:#9ca3af;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;text-align:center">© 2026 Mega Book Inc. — <i>footer</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;footer&gt; &lt;p&gt;© 2026 Mega Book Inc.&lt;/p&gt; &lt;/footer&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>list-style-position</b> = <b>inside</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>footer { list-style-position: inside; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Parent selector! Limits an element&#x27;s side effects (layout, paint, size, style) to its subtree.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dialog&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:240px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);padding:14px;font-size:13px"><b>Are you sure?</b><div style="margin-top:10px;text-align:right"><button style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f9fafb;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;margin-right:6px;font-size:12px">Cancel</button><button style="border:none;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:12px">OK</button></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dialog id=&quot;dlg&quot;&gt; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “The current value of inputs/outputs: text, number, date, file…”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>class</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>value</code></li><li>C. <code>inert</code></li><li>D. <code>itemtype</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5309">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5310 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5311">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5311" data-page="5311" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4434"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5311 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4434 — s × flex-basis</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">s</span> <span class="badge prop">flex-basis</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">flex-basis</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;s&gt;</code> — marks text that is no longer accurate or relevant (not a strikethrough for style). The item&#x27;s starting main-size before grow/shrink.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;s&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Price: <s style="color:#9ca3af">$99</s> <b>$79</b></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Price: &lt;s&gt;$99&lt;/s&gt; $79&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>flex-basis</b> = <b>0</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>s { flex-basis: 0; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which global attribute: “Any ARIA attribute (aria-label, aria-expanded, aria-hidden, aria-live…) adds accessibility semantics when native HTML is not enough.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>aria-…</code></li><li>B. <code>dir</code></li><li>C. <code>itemid</code></li><li>D. <code>part</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5310">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5311 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5312">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5312" data-page="5312" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4435"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5312 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4435 — dfn × grid-auto-columns</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dfn</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-auto-columns</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-auto-columns</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dfn&gt;</code> — the term being defined on the page. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A neutral block-level container with no semantic meaning.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;abbr&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;legend&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;figcaption&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;div&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5314">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5315 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5316">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5316" data-page="5316" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4439"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5316 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4439 — iframe × background-repeat</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">iframe</span> <span class="badge prop">background-repeat</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-repeat</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;iframe&gt;</code> — embeds another html page in a nested browsing context. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Content tangentially related to the main content (sidebar, box, pull quote).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;aside&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;time&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;caption&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;h3&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5315">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5316 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5317">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5317" data-page="5317" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4440"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5317 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4440 — input × isolation</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">input</span> <span class="badge prop">isolation</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">isolation</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;input&gt;</code> — the most versatile form control: text, email, number, date, file, checkbox, radio, range, color, search and more. Isolate the element from blend modes above/below it.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;input&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><form style="display:grid;gap:8px;font-size:12px;max-width:250px"><label style="display:grid;gap:3px"><b>Full name</b><input style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></label><label style="display:grid;gap:3px"><b>Email</b><input type="email" style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:5px 8px"></label><label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><input type="checkbox" checked> Newsletter</label><button style="justify-self:start;background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 16px">Send</button></form></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form&gt; required&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;Age &lt;input type=&quot;number&quot; name=&quot;age&quot; min=&quot;0&quot; max=&quot;120&quot;&gt; &lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;checkbox&quot; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Side comments and small print: fine print, copyrights, legal notes.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;param&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;html&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;code&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;small&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5325">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5326 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5327">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5327" data-page="5327" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4450"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5327 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4450 — p × grid-template-columns</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">p</span> <span class="badge prop">grid-template-columns</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">grid-template-columns</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;p&gt;</code> — a block of text — the basic unit of written content. The browser adds vertical space around it automatically.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;This is a paragraph of text.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>grid-template-columns</b> = <b>fit-content</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>p { grid-template-columns: fit-content; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A short inline quotation (rendered with quotation marks).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;form&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;base&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;q&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;sup&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5326">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5327 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5328">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5328" data-page="5328" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4451"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5328 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4451 — summary × justify-items</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">summary</span> <span class="badge prop">justify-items</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">justify-items</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;summary&gt;</code> — the visible caption of a &lt;details&gt; disclosure. What to show when text overflows a clipped box (ellipsis!).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;data&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Weight: <span title="85">85 kg</span> — value="85" is stored for machines</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Weight: &lt;data value=&quot;85&quot;&gt;85 kg&lt;/data&gt;&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-overflow</b> = <b>clip</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>data { text-overflow: clip; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Subscript text (rendered below the baseline).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;sub&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;fieldset&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;section&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;dl&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5329">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5330 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5331">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5331" data-page="5331" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4454"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5331 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4454 — sub × unicode-bidi</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">sub</span> <span class="badge prop">unicode-bidi</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">unicode-bidi</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;sub&gt;</code> — subscript text (rendered below the baseline). }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; or &lt;menu&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;tfoot&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;figcaption&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;canvas&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;li&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5332">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5333 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5334">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5334" data-page="5334" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4457"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5334 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4457 — math × touch-action</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">math</span> <span class="badge prop">touch-action</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">touch-action</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;math&gt;</code> — mathematical notation using mathml. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “The description (details) for a term in a description list.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;td&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;h3&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;iframe&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;dd&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5333">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5334 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5335">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5335" data-page="5335" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4458"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5335 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4458 — form × will-change</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">form</span> <span class="badge prop">will-change</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">will-change</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;form&gt;</code> — a section for user input, submitted to a server. Hint: the element will change this property soon (promote it to a layer).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;form&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><form style="display:flex;gap:6px"><input placeholder="Search…" style="flex:1;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:12px"><button style="background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 14px;font-size:12px">Search</button></form></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form action=&quot;/search&quot; method=&quot;get&quot;&gt; &lt;input name=&quot;q&quot; placeholder=&quot;Search…&quot; required&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;submit&quot;&gt;Search&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>will-change</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>form { will-change: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A candidate resource for &lt;video&gt;, &lt;audio&gt; or &lt;picture&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;marquee&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;h6&gt;</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>&lt;source&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;param&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5334">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5335 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5336">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5336" data-page="5336" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4459"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5336 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4459 — textarea × animation-fill-mode</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">textarea</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-fill-mode</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-fill-mode</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;textarea&gt;</code> — a multi-line plain-text input field. Which styles apply before start / after end.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;textarea&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px;max-width:220px"><b style="font-size:11px">Message</b><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:6px 8px;color:#9ca3af;min-height:44px">Write here…</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;label&gt;Message &lt;textarea rows=&quot;3&quot; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “Captions, subtitles or chapters for &lt;video&gt;/&lt;audio&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;track&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;strike&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;br&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;form&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5335">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5336 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5337">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5337" data-page="5337" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4460"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5337 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4460 — colgroup × offset-distance</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">colgroup</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-distance</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-distance</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;colgroup&gt;</code> — groups columns so they can be styled via &lt;col&gt;. Forward / reverse / alternate playback.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;code&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Use <code style="font-family:monospace;background:#eef2ff;color:#4338ca;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px">display: grid</code> for layouts.</p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Use &lt;code&gt;display: grid&lt;/code&gt; for layouts.&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-direction</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>code { animation-direction: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Horizontal offset from the left.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>place-content</code></li><li>B. <code>forced-color-adjust</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>left</code></li><li>D. <code>animation-range</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5366">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5367 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5368">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5368" data-page="5368" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4491"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5368 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4491 — bdi × offset-path</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">bdi</span> <span class="badge prop">offset-path</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">offset-path</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;bdi&gt;</code> — isolates text so its direction does not affect surrounding text. Distance above the element (outside its border).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dd&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;color:#4b5563;margin-left:18px">World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet. <i>(dd)</i></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dl&gt;&lt;dt&gt;Web&lt;/dt&gt;&lt;dd&gt;World Wide Web — the document-based part of the Internet.&lt;/dd&gt;&lt;/dl&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>margin-top</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dd { margin-top: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which CSS property: “Vertical overflow behavior.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>font-size</code></li><li>B. <code>mask-image</code></li><li>C. <code>scale</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>overflow-y</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5368">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5369 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5370">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5370" data-page="5370" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4493"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5370 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4493 — canvas × border</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">canvas</span> <span class="badge prop">border</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">border</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;canvas&gt;</code> — a bitmap drawing surface controlled by the 2d api or webgl. width=&quot;200&quot; height=&quot;80&quot;&gt;&lt;/canvas&gt; &lt;script&gt; const x = document.querySelector(&quot;#c&quot;).getContext(&quot;2d&quot;); x.fillStyle = &quot;#4285f4&quot;; x.fillRect(10, 10, 80, 40); &lt;optgroup label=&quot;Fruits&quot;&gt; &lt;option&gt;Apple&lt;/option&gt; &lt;option&gt;Banana&lt;/option&gt; &lt;/optgroup&gt; &lt;/select&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>content-visibility</b> = <b>visible</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>optgroup { content-visibility: visible;
