Turn OpenType features on/off (ligatures, tabular nums…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;ruby&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;font-family:serif"><ruby>中<rt style="font-size:9px">zhōng</rt></ruby>国<rp>(</rp><rt style="font-size:9px">guó</rt><rp>)</rp></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ruby&gt;中&lt;rt&gt;zhōng&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;&lt;ruby&gt;国&lt;rt&gt;guó&lt;/rt&gt;&lt;/ruby&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>font-feature-settings</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>ruby { font-feature-settings: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches by unique id.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>#id</code></li><li>B. <code>:first-child</code></li><li>C. <code>:not(sel)</code></li><li>D. <code>:target</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5421">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5422 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5423">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5423" data-page="5423" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4546"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5423 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4546 — li × text-decoration-thickness</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">li</span> <span class="badge prop">text-decoration-thickness</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">text-decoration-thickness</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;li&gt;</code> — a single item inside &lt;ul&gt;, &lt;ol&gt; or &lt;menu&gt;. Thickness of the decoration line.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;li&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><ol style="font-size:13px;margin:0;padding-left:22px;line-height:1.7"><li>Start</li><li value="10">Jumps to 10</li><li>Then 11</li></ol></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;ol&gt; &lt;li&gt;Start&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li value=&quot;10&quot;&gt;Jumps to 10&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;Then 11&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ol&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>text-decoration-thickness</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>li { text-decoration-thickness: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The value starts with the string.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:nth-child(n)</code></li><li>B. <code>:has(sel)</code></li><li>C. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5422">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5423 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5424">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5424" data-page="5424" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4547"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5424 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4547 — video × direction</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">video</span> <span class="badge prop">direction</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">direction</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;video&gt;</code> — embeds a video player with optional controls, autoplay, loop and captions. Base text direction of the element (ltr / rtl).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;video&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="width:230px;height:120px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e3a5f,#0f172a);border-radius:8px;position:relative"><span style="position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center"><span style="width:0;height:0;border-left:22px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);border-top:14px solid transparent;border-bottom:14px solid transparent"></span></span><span style="position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:8px;font-size:10px;color:#e5e7eb">▶ clip.mp4 — controls</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;video controls width=&quot;320&quot; poster=&quot;thumb.jpg&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.webm&quot; type=&quot;video/webm&quot;&gt; &lt;source src=&quot;clip.mp4&quot; type=&quot;video/mp4&quot;&gt; &lt;track kind=&quot;captions&quot; src=&quot;en.vtt&quot; srclang=&quot;en&quot; label=&quot;EN&quot;&gt; &lt;/video&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>direction</b> = <b>ltr</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>video { direction: ltr; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Matches an element in a state.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:last-of-type</code></li><li>B. <code>:required / :optional</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:</code></li><li>D. <code>~</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5423">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5424 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5425">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5425" data-page="5425" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4548"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5425 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4548 — embed × background-clip</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">embed</span> <span class="badge prop">background-clip</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">background-clip</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;embed&gt;</code> — embeds an external application (legacy plugin interface). How far the background is painted (border-box / padding-box / content-box / text).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;embed&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;width:220px;padding:10px;background:#f9fafb;font-size:11px;font-family:monospace">document.pdf<br><span style="color:#6b7280">application/pdf — 100% × 400</span></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;embed src=&quot;document.pdf&quot; type=&quot;application/pdf&quot; width=&quot;100%&quot; height=&quot;400&quot;&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>background-clip</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>embed { background-clip: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Focus via keyboard (not mouse click).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:focus-visible</code></li><li>B. <code>:is(sel, …)</code></li><li>C. <code>:in-range / :out-of-range</code></li><li>D. <code>::first-letter</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5424">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5425 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5426">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5426" data-page="5426" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4549"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5426 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4549 — button × clip-path</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">button</span> <span class="badge prop">clip-path</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">clip-path</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;button&gt;</code> — a clickable button: submit, reset, or script-triggered action. Clip the element to a shape or path (non-rectangular boxes!).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;button&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button style="background:#2563eb;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 16px;font-size:12px">Search (submit)</button><button style="background:#f3f4f6;color:#374151;border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:6px;padding:7px 14px;font-size:12px">Clear (button)</button></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;form&gt; &lt;input name=&quot;q&quot; required&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;submit&quot;&gt;Search&lt;/button&gt; &lt;button type=&quot;button&quot; id=&quot;clear&quot;&gt;Clear&lt;/button&gt; &lt;/form&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>clip-path</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>button { clip-path: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Last child of its parent.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:last-child</code></li><li>B. <code>:checked</code></li><li>C. <code>:dir(dir)</code></li><li>D. <code>::placeholder</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5425">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5426 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5427">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5427" data-page="5427" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4550"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5427 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4550 — fieldset × user-select</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">fieldset</span> <span class="badge prop">user-select</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">user-select</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;fieldset&gt;</code> — groups related form controls with a border and a &lt;legend&gt; caption. Whether the text can be selected by the user.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;fieldset&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 12px 10px 4px;font-size:12px;max-width:250px"><span style="position:relative;top:-13px;left:8px;background:#fff;padding:0 6px;font-weight:600">Delivery</span><div style="display:grid;gap:5px;margin-top:4px"><label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><input type="radio" name="d" checked> Standard (3 days)</label><label style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><input type="radio" name="d"> Express (1 day, +$5)</label></div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;fieldset&gt; &lt;legend&gt;Delivery&lt;/legend&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;radio&quot; name=&quot;d&quot; checked&gt; Standard (3 days)&lt;/label&gt; &lt;label&gt;&lt;input type=&quot;radio&quot; name=&quot;d&quot;&gt; Express (1 day, +$5)&lt;/label&gt; &lt;/fieldset&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>user-select</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>fieldset { user-select: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The n-th child OF ITS TAG type (ignores other tags).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:valid / :invalid</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>C. <code>+</code></li><li>D. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5426">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5427 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5428">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5428" data-page="5428" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4551"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5428 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4551 — thead × field-sizing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">thead</span> <span class="badge prop">field-sizing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">field-sizing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;thead&gt;</code> — groups the header rows of a table. Let an input/textarea size itself to its content (content-based width).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;thead&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:11px;display:flex"><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px">Name</div><div style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;font-weight:700;padding:4px 10px">Role</div></div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;thead&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Name&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;Role&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/thead&gt; &lt;tbody&gt;…&lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>field-sizing</b> = <b>none</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>thead { field-sizing: none; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “No children at all (not even text).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:target</code></li><li>B. <code>::after</code></li><li>C. <code>element</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:empty</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5427">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5428 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5429">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5429" data-page="5429" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4552"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5429 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4552 — center × animation-delay</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">center</span> <span class="badge prop">animation-delay</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">animation-delay</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;center&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: center (obsolete). Delay before the first cycle starts.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;center&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="text-align:center;font-size:13px;background:#f3f4f6;padding:6px">Centered via CSS, not &lt;center&gt;</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;center&gt;Centered text&lt;/center&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>animation-delay</b> = <b>time</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>center { animation-delay: time; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Like :is but with ZERO specificity.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>::selection</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr]</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:where(sel, …)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5428">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5429 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5430">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5430" data-page="5430" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4553"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5430 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4553 — frame × scale</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">frame</span> <span class="badge prop">scale</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">scale</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;frame&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: frame (obsolete). Independent scale (composes with transform).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;frame&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;font-size:11px;background:#fef2f2;border:1px solid #fecaca;border-radius:6px;padding:8px">frameset/frame → dead since HTML5. Use <iframe> or real CSS layout.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;frameset&gt;&lt;frame src=&quot;nav.html&quot;&gt;&lt;frame src=&quot;main.html&quot;&gt;&lt;/frameset&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>scale</b> = <b>…</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>frame { scale: …; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Form control usable or not.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>:enabled / :disabled</code></li><li>B. <code>~</code></li><li>C. <code>::backdrop</code></li><li>D. <code>[attr$=…]</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5429">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5430 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5431">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5431" data-page="5431" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4554"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5431 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4554 — dir × aspect-ratio</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dir</span> <span class="badge prop">aspect-ratio</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">aspect-ratio</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dir&gt;</code> — legacy/obsolete element: directory list (obsolete). Locks the width:height ratio (16/9, 1/1, 4/3…).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;dir&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:12px">Use <ul>/<ol> and style with CSS list-style.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;dir&gt;&lt;item&gt;a&lt;/item&gt;&lt;item&gt;b&lt;/item&gt;&lt;/dir&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>aspect-ratio</b> = <b>auto</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>dir { aspect-ratio: auto; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “The placeholder is currently visible (field empty).”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::first-letter</code></li><li>B. <code>*</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>:placeholder-shown</code></li><li>D. <code>:hover</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5430">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5431 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5432">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5432" data-page="5432" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4555"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5432 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4555 — head × padding-inline</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">head</span> <span class="badge prop">padding-inline</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">padding-inline</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;head&gt;</code> — container for all machine-oriented information about the document. Logical left+right padding (flips with direction).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;head&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-family:monospace;background:#f6f8fa;padding:10px;border:1px solid #d0d7de">&lt;head&gt; = title + meta + link + style + script (invisible)</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;head&gt; &lt;meta charset=&quot;UTF-8&quot;&gt; &lt;title&gt;My Page&lt;/title&gt; &lt;/head&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>padding-inline</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>head { padding-inline: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Element&#x27;s language matches the code.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>::placeholder</code></li><li>B. <code>#id</code></li><li>C. <code>:active</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>:lang(code)</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5431">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5432 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5433">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5433" data-page="5433" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4556"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5433 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4556 — noscript × box-shadow</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">noscript</span> <span class="badge prop">box-shadow</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">box-shadow</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;noscript&gt;</code> — content rendered only when scripting is disabled or unsupported. One or more shadows around the box.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;noscript&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><div style="font-size:13px;background:#fff8e1;border:1px solid #ffe082;color:#795548;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px">⚠ You need to enable JavaScript to view this map.</div></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;noscript&gt;You need to enable JavaScript to view this map.&lt;/noscript&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>box-shadow</b> = <b>multiple</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>noscript { box-shadow: multiple; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Any depth descendant.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>descendant (space)</code></li><li>B. <code>::file-selector-button</code></li><li>C. <code>[attr^=…]</code></li><li>D. <code>:only-child</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5432">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5433 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5434">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5434" data-page="5434" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4557"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5434 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4557 — nav × overflow-wrap</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">nav</span> <span class="badge prop">overflow-wrap</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">overflow-wrap</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;nav&gt;</code> — a major block of navigation links. Break long words so they don&#x27;t overflow (break-word).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;nav&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><nav style="background:#1f2937;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 4px;display:flex;gap:4px"><a href="#" style="color:#d1d5db;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 10px;background:#374151;border-radius:6px">Home</a><a href="#" style="color:#d1d5db;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 10px">About</a><a href="#" style="color:#d1d5db;font-size:12px;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 10px">Contact</a></nav></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;nav&gt; &lt;ul&gt; &lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;/&quot;&gt;Home&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt; &lt;li&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;/about&quot;&gt;About&lt;/a&gt;&lt;/li&gt; &lt;/ul&gt; &lt;/nav&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>overflow-wrap</b> = <b>normal</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>nav { overflow-wrap: normal; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">What does this selector do? “Generated content INSIDE the start of the element.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>element</code></li><li>B. <code>:</code></li><li>C. <code>:first-of-type</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>::before</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5433">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5434 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5435">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5435" data-page="5435" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4558"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5435 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4558 — h1 × align-content</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">h1</span> <span class="badge prop">align-content</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">align-content</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;h1&gt;</code> — a section heading of importance level 1 (h1 = highest). “The text cues of media &lt;track&gt; subtitles.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>:hover</code></li><li>B. <code>:nth-of-type(n)</code></li><li>✔ C. <code>::cue</code></li><li>D. <code>:required / :optional</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5436">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5437 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5438">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5438" data-page="5438" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4561"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5438 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4561 — s × word-spacing</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">s</span> <span class="badge prop">word-spacing</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">word-spacing</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;s&gt;</code> — marks text that is no longer accurate or relevant (not a strikethrough for style). Extra space between words.</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;s&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><p style="margin:0;font-size:13px">Price: <s style="color:#9ca3af">$99</s> <b>$79</b></p></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;p&gt;Price: &lt;s&gt;$99&lt;/s&gt; $79&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>word-spacing</b> = <b>length</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>s { word-spacing: length; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which is a valid value of width?</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>auto</code></li><li>✔ B. <code>fit-content</code></li><li>C. <code>auto2</code></li><li>D. <code>never</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5437">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5438 / 8000 · Practice 23</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5439">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5439" data-page="5439" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4562"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 23</span><span>Page 5439 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4562 — dfn × white-space</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">dfn</span> <span class="badge prop">white-space</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">white-space</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;dfn&gt;</code> — the term being defined on the page. }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A single choice inside &lt;select&gt; or &lt;datalist&gt;.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>A. <code>&lt;del&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;small&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;colgroup&gt;</code></li><li>✔ D. <code>&lt;option&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5498">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5499 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="#p5500">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <section class="page" id="p5500" data-page="5500" data-tag="drill" data-title="Drill 4623"> <div class="pg-head"><span class="crumb">Part VI — The 8000 Practice Pages · Practice 24</span><span>Page 5500 of 8000</span></div> <h2>Drill 4623 — table × line-height</h2><div class="crumb-row"><span class="badge tag">table</span> <span class="badge prop">line-height</span></div><p class="sum">Apply <code class="prop">line-height</code> to <code class="tag">&lt;table&gt;</code> — a two-dimensional table of data. The height of each line box (vertical rhythm).</p><h3>1 · The element</h3><div class="demo"><div class="demo-bar"><span></span><span></span><span></span><em>&lt;table&gt; as rendered</em></div><div class="demo-body"><table style="border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px;width:210px"><caption style="caption-side:top;font-weight:600;padding:4px">Monthly sales</caption><thead><tr><th style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;padding:4px 8px;text-align:left">Month</th><th style="border:1px solid #d1d5db;background:#f3f4f6;padding:4px 8px;text-align:left">Sales</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 8px">Aug</td><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 8px">$12,400</td></tr><tr><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 8px">Sep</td><td style="border:1px solid #e5e7eb;padding:4px 8px">$14,100</td></tr></tbody></table></div></div><h3>2 · Starter code</h3><pre class="code"><code>&lt;table&gt; &lt;caption&gt;Monthly sales&lt;/caption&gt; &lt;thead&gt;&lt;tr&gt;&lt;th&gt;Month&lt;/th&gt;&lt;th&gt;Sales&lt;/th&gt;&lt;/tr&gt;&lt;/thead&gt; &lt;tbody&gt; &lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Aug&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;$12,400&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt; &lt;tr&gt;&lt;td&gt;Sep&lt;/td&gt;&lt;td&gt;$14,100&lt;/td&gt;&lt;/tr&gt; &lt;/tbody&gt; &lt;/table&gt;</code></pre><h3>3 · Your task</h3><ul><li>Write one CSS rule that applies <b>line-height</b> = <b>number</b> to the element.</li><li>Explain (1 sentence) what changes in the browser.</li></ul><h3>4 · Solution</h3><pre class="code"><code>table { line-height: number; }</code></pre><h3>5 · Value quick-quiz</h3><p class="mut">Which element is described by: “A multi-line plain-text input field.”</p><ul class="quiz"><li>✔ A. <code>&lt;textarea&gt;</code></li><li>B. <code>&lt;head&gt;</code></li><li>C. <code>&lt;q&gt;</code></li><li>D. <code>&lt;tbody&gt;</code></li></ul> <div class="pg-foot"> <a data-nav="prev" href="#p5499">← Prev</a> <span class="num">Page 5500 / 8000 · Practice 24</span> <a data-nav="next" href="../volumes/vol-12.html#p5501">Next →</a> <span class="jump">Go to <input class="jump-input" type="number" min="1" max="8000" placeholder="page"> <a href="../index.html">🗺 Map</a></span> </div> </section> <script> (function(){ var pageEl = document.querySelector('.page[data-page]'); if(!pageEl) return; // hash scroll function goHash(){ if(location.hash){ var t = document.querySelector(location.hash); if(t) t.scrollIntoView(); } } window.addEventListener('load', goHash); window.addEventListener('hashchange', goHash); // keyboard document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.target.matches('input,textarea')) return; if(e.key === 'ArrowRight'){ var n = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="next"]'); if(n) n.click(); } if(e.key === 'ArrowLeft'){ var p = document.querySelector('a[data-nav="prev"]'); if(p) p.click(); } }); // jump (every page has one) var boxes = document.querySelectorAll('.jump-input'); for(var bi = 0; bi < boxes.length; bi++){ (function(box){ box.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key !== 'Enter') return; var n = parseInt(box.value, 10); if(!n || n < 1 || n > 8000){ box.value=''; box.placeholder='1–8000'; return; } var vol = Math.ceil(n / 500); location.href = 'vol-' + String(vol).padStart(2, '0') + '.html' + '#p' + n; }); })(boxes[bi]); } })(); </script> </body> </html>
